From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Medixa procurement - onboarding evidence gate & PO routing

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Per our discussion, we want to kick off the procurement onboarding so your finance and security teams have everything they need to issue a PO and move the pilot to activation. To make the intake concise for your procurement gate, please see the ask below and a proposed path for PO routing/invoicing.

Quick checklist we can provide right away (we'll attach files in a follow-up):
- SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where needed)
- ISO 27001 certificate snapshot
- Pen-test attestation letter (summary + contact)
- Vendor tax form (W-9) and remit/invoice instructions
- Short data handling summary (how token data is stored/retained for hosted customers)

Questions for you so we can align the intake:
1) Will your procurement team accept redacted SOC 2 + letter of attestation, or do you need the full report under an NDA?
2) Do you have a preferred PO template or DocuSign flow (we can sign on a DocuSign PO link)?
3) Target PO date for pilot start (you mentioned mid-April on the call) — is that still realistic?

Initial suggested invoice terms: Net 30, remit to the address on the attached W-9. If your procurement requires alternate billing codes or a vendor portal upload, please share the link/portal contact and we'll complete onboarding within 48 business hours of receiving the PO.

I'll drop the attachments in a secure Drive folder and send the DocuSign link for the sample PO. Monica will own finance coordination; Karthik will handle any technical evidence questions.

Next step: Claire — could you confirm the procurement contact and preferred delivery method for compliance artifacts?

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Jonas / team —

Appreciate the clear checklist. Procurement here requires the following artifacts before we can issue a PO for the pilot:
- SOC 2 Type II (or Type II + letter of attestation). If full report is large, a redacted copy is fine if it includes the auditor scope and exception statement.
- ISO 27001 certificate (pdf)
- Penetration test attestation letter (dated within last 12 months)
- Vendor W-9 and remit instructions for invoicing
- Short description of data residency and retention for hosted tenant data (1-2 paragraphs is fine)

A few notes about timing and process:
- We typically require artifacts to be uploaded to our vendor portal (https://vendors.medixa.com/upload) and the procurement@medixa.com mailbox copied on delivery.
- PO cadence: Procurement will aim to issue a PO within 10 business days of receiving evidence; target close date we've been given internally is 2027-04-21 for pilot start.
- Our legal has a standard purchase order; if you have counter-terms, please send a redline to legal@medixa.com.

For now, please upload files and confirm whether redaction is needed for SOC 2. If any documents require an NDA, let us know and we'll get it routed.

Thanks,

Claire Huang
Senior Procurement Manager
Medixa Health

Claire —

Thanks for the details and the vendor portal link. We're uploading artifacts now. Quick notes and actions from our side:

What you'll see uploaded to your vendor portal folder (and linked to procurement@medixa.com):
- SOC2_TypeII_redwood_2026.pdf (redacted auditor sections; full scope included) [Attachment]
- ISO27001_certificate_snapshot.pdf [Attachment]
- pen-test-attestation-letter.pdf (summary + contact for the third-party pentest firm) [Attachment]
- redwood_vendor_w9.pdf [Attachment]
- data_handling_summary.txt (short 2-paragraph summary included inline below)

Data handling summary (uploaded and included here):
Redwood Inference hosts tenant metadata in a multi-tenant control plane with optional private deployment for customers that require isolation. For hosted accounts, model inputs are transient: token streaming is processed in-memory by our inference runtime and logs are retained only for telemetry and billing for up to 30 days by default; customers can opt-in to zero-retention or self-managed solutions in Private deployments. We encrypt data at rest and in transit; key management integrates with customer KMS for Private deployments.

PO / invoicing confirmation:
- We can accept a Net 30 PO and invoice to the remit address on the W-9.
- DocuSign: We'll accept your DocuSign PO link (please share) or we can sign and return a standard Medixa PO as-is.

If procurement/legal need a redline, please have them send the draft to legal@redwood.com — Monica will coordinate the invoicing details and will be the point for billing exceptions.

Next steps:
1) I'll upload the files to your vendor portal by EOD PT and copy procurement@medixa.com.
2) Jonas, Monica and I will be available for any follow-ups during the PO review window.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer
